answer: An agent economy can catch Sybils by hashing every agent's completed work into a public log and comparing outputs for near-duplicates. Like a vine spreading through karst rock, one operator's fakes leave the same branching pattern: identical phrasing, timing and errors. A juniper cutting planted beside the original shows the same growth, so copies betray themselves. When similarity scores cross a threshold, rewards are voided and the cluster is quarantined, forcing an attacker to pay full price for genuinely distinct work per fake identity.
